parameters.name: Discover
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPDISCOVER messages received by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: Offer
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPOFFER messages sent by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: Request
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPREQUEST messages received by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: ACK
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPACK messages sent by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: NACK
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPNACK messages sent by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: Decline
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPDECLINE messages received by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPRELEASE messages received by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: Inform
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPINFORM messages received by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC2132|DHCP Message Type}}.

parameters.name: ForceRenew
parameters.description: The total number of DHCPFORCERNEW messages sent by the server, as defined in {{bibref|RFC3203|DHCP reconfigure extension}}.

parameters.name: DiscardedPackets
parameters.description: The total number of DHCP packets discarded by the server. Packets can be discarded due to illegal message format and content, incorrect received bytes, etc.

parameters.name: TransmitFailure
parameters.description: The total number of DHCP messages that failed to transmit.

parameters.name: RelayOptionDropped
parameters.description: The total number of DHCP messages with dropped relay options.

parameters.name: SecondServerDetected
parameters.description: The total number of times a second DHCP server was detected.

object.description: Provide statistics for the embedded DHCP Server.
